notificationSetup.title: Agent notification integration
notificationSetup.description: CLI availability and notification readiness are separate. Probing prepares supported hooks or plugins only for AgentPort-managed Sessions, merging global registration when needed while preserving existing settings and supporting rollback. Setup failure does not prevent basic startup.
notificationSetup.nextStart: Changes apply to newly started or restarted Sessions. Existing Sessions are not restarted. Notification channels and switches remain unchanged; integration readiness does not grant system notification permission.
notificationSetup.table: Agent CLI availability and notification readiness
notificationSetup.notPrepared: No setup result yet. Probe the CLI to prepare supported notification integration.
notificationSetup.notInstalled: CLI not detected; probing will not install the Agent itself.
notificationSetup.probeUnavailable: The CLI probe did not return an available installation. Previous CLI selection is retained; see details or manage Agent installations.
notificationSetup.rollbackBody: Remove only AgentPort-managed notification changes, restoring preserved settings where safe. Later user edits will not be overwritten. The CLI and existing Sessions remain available; a future probe can configure integration again.
notificationSetup.rollbackFailed: Could not roll back {{agent}} notification integration: {{detail}}

commitAi.description: Configure an OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible service. AI features such as commit message generation in Git Center share this configuration.
commitAi.providerHint: AgentPort appends the standard message endpoint for the selected protocol.
commitAi.baseUrlHint: Enter a service root, version URL, or complete message endpoint. Only HTTP(S) is supported.
commitAi.httpWarning: HTTP sends the API key and staged diff in plaintext. Use it only for a trusted local service.
commitAi.modelHint: Enter a model ID that the compatible service actually provides.
commitAi.apiKeyConfigured: Configured; leave blank to keep it
commitAi.apiKeyKeepHint: Stored in system secure storage. Saving a blank field keeps the existing key.
commitAi.apiKeyStorageHint: Written only to macOS Keychain / Linux Secret Service, never to the settings database. The field is cleared immediately after a successful save.
commitAi.languageHint: Language used for generated commit subjects and bodies; future AI features will follow it.
commitAi.clearKeyTitle: Clear the AI provider API key?
commitAi.clearKeyBody: This deletes the credential from system secure storage. The Base URL and model remain configured.
commitAi.privacyBody: Only an explicit “Generate with AI” click in Git Center sends the staged diff, branch name, and recent commit subjects to the configured service. Unstaged and ignored files are not sent, and the result must still pass human review before commit.

backup.description: Back up and restore each agent separately. Archives include only its AgentPort-managed Sessions, related metadata and available native history. Restore merges missing Sessions without affecting other agents.
backup.dataBoundaryTitle: Backups contain sensitive plaintext and are not encrypted
backup.dataBoundaryBody: Captured native Sessions are written to the ZIP with complete conversations and tool output, which may include prompts, code, paths, previously printed Secret values, and other sensitive data. The backup is not encrypted; handle it as a sensitive file. Account credentials, Secret references and global configuration are excluded; sensitive values previously printed in conversations may still be included.

backup.verificationV2Incomplete: Valid v2 backup · incomplete native coverage (captured {{captured}}/{{total}}, missing {{missing}}, ambiguous {{ambiguous}}, unsupported {{unsupported}})
backup.restoreBody: Import only missing {{agent}} Sessions. Existing Sessions are kept and reported as skipped; other agents and global settings stay unchanged. Native history goes into the configured Provider home; different content at the same path is a conflict and is never overwritten. Legacy full backups are supported, but only the selected agent is imported. Restore does not start Sessions or recreate Worktrees.

backup.createHint: Saved under backups/ in the app data directory, then checked for native coverage and file integrity

pairing.description: Pair a phone and use terminal sessions through an end-to-end encrypted Relay.
pairing.requirements: Use your self-hosted Relay endpoint (wss://host/v1/relay). Both devices connect outbound; no SSH or direct phone-to-computer access is required. Scanning the QR automatically grants access without another confirmation. Keep this short-lived, one-time access code private. Opening AgentPort automatically starts or reuses the background connector without creating a pairing invitation or granting new access. It survives closing the app. Manual Stop lasts until you start it again or relaunch the app; no OS boot/login autostart is installed.
pairing.compare: Compare this code and the device name with your phone. Approve only if they match. This authorizes the phone to manage AgentPort sessions through Remote Bridge.
pairing.revokeHint: Revocation blocks new connections and closes this phone’s current Relay channels. Other phones and Session Hosts are not stopped. Existing manual SSH access is unchanged.
pairing.revokeConfirm: Revoke access and close Relay channels from {{name}}?
pairing.tokenHint: Stored in Keychain, never included in the QR or sent to the phone. Obtain it from your Relay operator. Saving configuration closes existing Relay channels; Session Hosts keep running. Deployment guide: crates/agentport-relay/README.md.
pairing.stopConfirm: Close all Relay channels and stop the background connector? Session Hosts will keep running.
